items.t: 137 Ventures’ Returns Soar on SpaceX, Anduril and Cognition Bets
items.d: The 2014 fund of early SpaceX backer 137 Ventures is now worth more than eight times the money investors originally put into it, net of fees and other charges.

items.t: NASA administrator explains how Roman Telescope will change understanding of the universe
items.d: NBC News' Gadi Schwartz speaks with NASA administrator Jared Isaacman about the Nancy Grace Roman Telescope launch, the Artemis III launch in 2027, and SpaceX's new Louisiana Starbase.

items.t: SpaceX wants to turn Louisiana marshland into a Starship hub
items.d: SpaceX's Elon Musk plans to build new Starship launchpads in Louisiana, replacing sections of marshland as part of a major spaceport project. Space journalist Kristin Fisher talks with NBC News' Gadi Schwartz about the plans.
